en.name: DevTac Ronin ballistic helmet (Olive)
en.description: A Japan-styled tactical helmet, manufactured by DevTac. Not used by any military or special forces. Just somehow happened to be in Tarkov for some frivolous price. Features a full protection of the whole head, but the armor class is not good enough to actually be useful in combat. Olive version.

en.name: Baseball cap (MultiCam)
en.description: A baseball cap in a MultiCam camouflage, worn strictly backwards. Once worn by a certain Obi-Blonde-Kenobi.

en.name: Baseball cap (Trauma)
en.description: A very stylish cap that shows its wearer can take any amount of lead-related hardship in stride. To be worn strictly backwards.

en.name: Baseball cap (Zaebtsa Woodland)
en.description: A baseball cap in a Woodland camouflage. For those who always wanna look "supreme".

en.name: Baseball cap (Zaebtsa Red Tiger Stripe)
en.description: A baseball cap in a red Tiger Stripe camouflage. For those who always wanna look "supreme".

en.name: Atlant Armour Titan Aramid helmet (EMR)
en.description: The Titan Aramid ballistic helmet in the form factor copying the Crye Precision AirFrame helmet. Made entirely of aramid, providing an optimal balance between protection and mobility. Equipped with accessory rails and a mount for additional devices. Manufactured by Atlant Armour. EMR camouflage version.

weaponPresets._name: Helmet Atlant Armour Titan Aramid EMR Standard

en.name: Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Botched)
en.description: The AirFrame ballistic helmet sets the standards in protection, comfort, and modularity. The unique overlapping shell design of the AirFrame creates an integrated vent that provides passive cooling and can reduce the damaging effects of explosive blast waves. Highly modular. Manufactured by Crye Precision. One of the Arena fighters tried painting this helmet in a MultiCam Black pattern, but that didn't really go as planned.

en.name: Diamond Age NovaSteel helmet (Custos Mortis)
en.description: The Diamond Age NovaSteel is an evolution of the NeoSteel helmet, featuring upgraded hardware made from reinforced fiberglass and a wider range of available accessories. Decorated by a veteran of the cleanup crew, with countless gladiators who crossed Ref on his kill list.

en.name: MTEK STRIKE Ballistic helmet (Carbon Fiber)
en.description: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Comes with a set of stickers imitating a carbon fiber look.

en.name: DevTac Ronin Respirator (LABS Security)
en.description: A Japan-styled tactical helmet, manufactured by DevTac. Not used by any military or special forces. Apparently, TerraGroup imported it to Tarkov specifically for lab security personnel working around hazardous chemicals. Unfortunately, it offered little practical protection, and the remaining stock was eventually sold off for next to nothing.

en.name: Altyn assault helmet (Impact Tested)
en.description: One of the most iconic ballistic helmets in the world, the Altyn has repeatedly proven itself in combat and remains in service with various organizations to this day. This particular helmet underwent extensive testing at a proving ground before faithfully serving one of the Arena fighters. It never let him down: poor training was his downfall, while the helmet is still ready to take a hit.

en.name: Diamond Age NovaSteel helmet (Olive Drab)
en.description: The Diamond Age NovaSteel is an evolution of the NeoSteel helmet, featuring upgraded hardware made from reinforced fiberglass and a wider range of available accessories. Olive Drab version.

en.name: Diamond Age NovaSteel helmet (Toxin)
en.description: The Diamond Age NovaSteel is an evolution of the NeoSteel helmet, featuring upgraded hardware made from reinforced fiberglass and a wider range of available accessories. The pattern on the helmet resembles the iconic poisonous gas seen in games and movies.
